/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3.12 -c 'from solution import load_people
h=\"name,email,age,active\\n\"
valid=[(\"quoted comma\",h+\"\\\"Doe, Sam\\\",sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n\",[{\"name\":\"Doe, Sam\",\"email\":\"sam@example.invalid\",\"age\":30,\"active\":True}]),(\"embedded newline\",h+\"\\\"Sam\\nSmith\\\",sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n\",[{\"name\":\"Sam\\nSmith\",\"email\":\"sam@example.invalid\",\"age\":30,\"active\":True}]),(\"BOM\",\"\\ufeff\"+h,[]),(\"false token\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,false\\n\",[{\"name\":\"Sam\",\"email\":\"sam@example.invalid\",\"age\":30,\"active\":False}]),(\"blank row\",h+\" , , , \\n\",[]),(\"header whitespace\",\" name , email , age , active \\nSam,sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n\",[{\"name\":\"Sam\",\"email\":\"sam@example.invalid\",\"age\":30,\"active\":True}]),(\"normalization\",h+\" Sam , SAM@example.invalid ,30,true\\n\",[{\"name\":\"Sam\",\"email\":\"sam@example.invalid\",\"age\":30,\"active\":True}])]
invalid=[(\"empty input\",\"\"),(\"duplicate header\",\"name,email,age,active,name\\n\"),(\"extra header\",\"name,email,age,active,extra\\n\"),(\"missing header\",\"name,email,age\\n\"),(\"short row\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30\\n\"),(\"long row\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true,extra\\n\"),(\"empty name\",h+\",sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n\"),(\"invalid email\",h+\"Sam,sam@@example.invalid,30,true\\n\"),(\"whitespace email\",h+\"Sam,sa m@example.invalid,30,true\\n\"),(\"negative age\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,-1,true\\n\"),(\"age above limit\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,131,true\\n\"),(\"signed age\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,+1,true\\n\"),(\"Unicode age\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,٣,true\\n\"),(\"invalid active\",h+\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,yes\\n\"),(\"malformed quoting\",h+\"\\\"Sam,sam@example.invalid,30,true\\n\")]
passed=0
for name,data,expected in valid+[(n,d,ValueError) for n,d in invalid]:
 try:
  actual=load_people(data); ok=expected is not ValueError and actual==expected; detail=repr(actual)
 except Exception as exc:
  ok=expected is ValueError and isinstance(exc,ValueError); detail=type(exc).__name__+\": \"+str(exc)
 passed+=ok
 print((\"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")+\" \"+name+\" -> \"+detail)
print(str(passed)+\"/\"+str(len(valid)+len(invalid))+\" supplemental checks passed\")'"
